design_description: A bold, electricity-inspired football jersey combining a deep black base with striking metallic gold lightning bolts, subtle charcoal graphics and crisp white detailing. Designed around the identity of Shumake Electric, the kit translates electrical power, energy and movement into a dynamic, high-impact visual concept. The front features aggressive, jagged gold lightning bolts emerging from both shoulders and sweeping diagonally across the lower torso. Thin, irregular gold electrical cracks accompany the larger shapes, while oversized dark charcoal lightning motifs create a subtle tone-on-tone background pattern, adding depth without overwhelming the composition. The chest remains predominantly black to ensure excellent visibility for the large SHUMAKE ELECTRIC sponsor, presented in bold white and gold typography. Above it sit the white Momuto logo and a distinctive electrical-themed team emblem incorporating a green lightbulb and plug. A black crew-neck collar with gold trim, double gold shoulder stripes and matching sleeve cuffs reinforce the coordinated black-and-gold identity. The back maintains the same lightning-inspired visual language, with charcoal electrical patterns extending across the shoulders and torso. A large diagonal gold lightning bolt dominates the lower section, creating continuity with the front. Bold gold player lettering sits above an oversized white number 10 with fine black detailing and miniature lightning symbols. A small gold neck tab featuring a black lightning bolt completes the design. The result is a powerful, contemporary black-and-gold kit that balances aggressive electrical graphics with clean branding, strong contrast and a cohesive front-to-back composition.
